entries.label: Wed 11 Nov
entries.title: Auction House changes held back, plus class and quest fixes

blocks.heading: Auction House
items: Blizzard has taken the Auction House and mail changes out of the 10 Nov hotfixes, so they are not live yet. They have been taken out of the 10 Nov notes here too.
That means the smallest deposit is still 1 silver for each listing.
Blizzard says the changes should come with the maintenance on 17 Nov, or in a later hotfix.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Shaman: If a totem went missing after Monday night's outage, Blizzard has now fixed it in all regions. The totem should be back in your bags.
Shaman: Flametongue Totem Rank 2 now works.
Druid: For Feral, Rend and Tear now works with Pounce Bleed.
Hunter: Volley no longer sets off proc effects. It also stops when you start moving.
Paladin: Judgement now counts as a ranged attack. It uses your ranged hit chance and no longer sets off melee effects.
Paladin: For Retribution, Unsealed Fury no longer echoes Windfury Totem attacks.
Priest: Gnomes can now use Confounding Flash in Shadowform. For Holy, Twilight Focus now works in Shadowform.

blocks.heading: Quests and world
items: Riverglades: Twilight Enforcers' Smash now does much less damage, and Executioner Morg hits less hard. The Twilight Forgemaster's Mark of Flames now adds 50 damage, down from 1,000.
Western Plaguelands: you can now use the Command Tent for "Scarlet Diversions".
Arathi Highlands: the Witherbark Mallet works again, so you can carry on with "The Giant in the Den".
Feralas: the cage door for "Freedom for All Creatures" now resets.
Shen'dralas: you can mount up again in its named areas.

blocks.heading: Items and professions
items: Bloody Claws of Attack now give the +1 weapon skill they should.
Earthen Silk Slippers no longer give more spell damage than intended.

Tailoring: five bags now need one more bolt of cloth. Red and Green Woolen Bags: 5 Bolts of Woolen Cloth, 10 slots. Green Silk Pack: 5 Bolts of Silk Cloth, 12 slots. Black Silk Pack: 6 Bolts of Silk Cloth, 12 slots. Red Mageweave Bag: 5 Bolts of Mageweave, 14 slots.

blocks.heading: Also
items: Blizzard has switched off the Item Restoration service for now while it fixes a serious bug.

After Wednesday morning's EU maintenance, some players saw "No realms are currently available" (WOW51900309). Blizzard support says this means you need the latest game update. Close the game, let the Battle.net app download the update, then start the game again.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, or on restoring other progress lost in Monday night's outage.

entries.label: Tue 10 Nov
entries.title: Class tuning is live, plus quest and profession fixes

blocks.heading: Classes
items: The class tuning Blizzard promised for Tue 10 Nov has now gone live.
Hunter: Pet health is now 115% of normal, down from 150%. Hawk pets hit about 80% harder. Arcane Shot and Summon Hawk now cost 11% of your base mana at every rank.
Warlock: Your Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus and Succubus have about 15% more health. The Imp's first four Firebolt ranks hit harder.

Warlock: For Affliction, Wrack does 30% less damage and is now a 6-second channel. While you channel it, Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick twice as fast. Soul Siphon now boosts Drain Life, Drain Soul and Wrack for each of those spells on the target, up to 36%.
Shaman: Weapon imbues and weapon totems now work together. Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem can both trigger on the same hits.

Shaman: For Enhancement, Stormstrike now does 100% weapon damage, down from 150%, on an 8-second cooldown. Mental Dexterity turns less Intellect into attack power. Maelstrom Weapon cuts cast time and mana by 20% per stack at every rank, but triggers less often. Blizzard says this moves Enhancement back towards Windfury and away from Spell Power gear.
Shaman: Rage of the Storm, the Shaman quest reward, now gives 16 Strength instead of 16 Intellect. Its speed is now 3.6.
Druid: Omen of Clarity works again after you switch specs. For Restoration, Nature's Swiftness also makes Wild Growth instant.
Warrior: For Arms, Sweeping Strikes no longer uses up charges when there is no second target.

blocks.heading: Quests and world
items: Most quests from level 48 upwards now also give gold. Level 60 quests do not turn XP into gold.
Shatterspear Trolls no longer give XP.
Riverglades: many more Glade Vipers for "Poison Tips".
Duskwood: more Nightbane worgen for "Worgen in the Woods".
Murloc Tideskimmers now drop Saltwater Murloc Eyes for "A Taste of the Sea".
Feralas: you can start "Rescue OOX-22/FE!" again.
Zephras Isle: "Camping 101: Herbalism" now completes in Shen'dar Village.
The Broken Frond of Celastrus now drops for everyone in your group.
You no longer get sent to the wrong graveyard when you die.
The people of Pyrewood Village now appear at dawn and dusk as intended.
Racial mounts from vendors are now Bind on Pickup, so you can't buy them for another character.

blocks.heading: Professions
items: Cooking: the Journeyman Campfire Kit now needs Cooking 90, down from 140.
Blacksmithing: Coarse Grinding Stones now give skill-ups up to 90, up from 75.
Alchemy: Minor Arcane Elixir sells to vendors for 5 copper, down from 25. Recipe: Elixir of Greater Firepower is now called Recipe: Elixir of Holy Power.
Enchanting: the Lesser Spirit enchants for boots and bracers now give Spirit. The Arcane Salvager now needs a Runed Golden Rod.
Engineering: Iron Grenades now cost 1 silver 25 copper from vendors, down from 5 silver.
Some crafted Bind on Pickup armour from Leatherworking, Tailoring and Blacksmithing now sells to vendors for less.
Fishing: Fishing Racks give lures more reliably. Blizzard knows about other rack problems, such as the "There is no loot" error.

blocks.heading: Also
items: For now, Blizzard is limiting new characters on the busier faction. That means Horde on North American PvP realms and Alliance on EU Roleplay-PvP realms.
Still no word on the proper fix for boats and zeppelins, or on restoring progress lost in Monday night's outage.

entries.label: Mon 9 Nov
entries.title: Smaller crowds, easier dungeons and many quest fixes

blocks.heading: World
items: Blizzard lowered the number of players in zones that were very crowded. The change was bigger on PvP realms.
The flight from Camp Taurajo to Thunder Bluff no longer flies through objects.

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Warlock: Finishing "Summon Felsteed" now teaches you riding. If you finished it earlier, summon your Felsteed once to get Apprentice Riding.
Druid: Feral Charge in Cat Form puts you in combat straight away. Natural Instinct now works with Lacerate and Pounce.
Hunter: You no longer pull far-away monsters just by targeting them.
Mage: Flamestrike's burning ground no longer uses up Clearcasting.
Priest: Casting Fear Ward no longer knocks you out of Shadowform.
Shaman: Lightning Overload now does the right Lightning Bolt damage.

blocks.heading: Dungeons
items: The Drowned City: monsters were hitting about 30% too hard. That is fixed.
Deathless Marrow: monsters have 25% less health. Some of their attacks are weaker or used less often.
Blackfathom Deeps: you can release your spirit after dying again.
Alcaz Prison: Zarla Ober now drops loot.
Waylaid Crates and Craftsman's Writs now drop inside dungeons.

blocks.heading: Monsters, quests and items
items: Un'Goro Crater: Young Diemetradons are now level 51 to 52, not 58.
Silverpine Forest: Ivar the Foul respawns at the right speed. Teldrassil: Ferocitas the Dream Eater spawns sooner.
Quest items for "The Monster Surfaces", "Croaky's Head" and "Elmpaw's Head" are now shared with your group.
Fixed: "Ever After", "Unwelcome Guests", "A Recipe for Death", "Fetch 'n' Fletch" and Jom-jom's escape.
"Feathers in Flight": you can loot the Hyjal Owl Nests before level 60.
Henrig Lonebrow's Journal respawns faster.
The Pouch of Violet Dust now gives the extra hour of Camp Benefits.
The Nifty Stopwatch no longer shares a cooldown with Sprint, Dash and Blink.
The servers went down for emergency maintenance at about 9:30pm UK time. They were back by about 10:45pm. Some players had to restart the game.
Players say some progress from just before the outage was lost. Spells they had trained and profession skill-ups were gone, but the gold they spent stayed spent. A few lost quest items.
Blizzard has not yet said whether anything will be restored. Check your spellbook and profession skill when you next log in, and retrain if you need to.
Monsters in dungeons now give 50% more XP. The change went live on Sunday evening.

entries.label: Fri 6 Nov
entries.title: Second round of hotfixes, and class tuning on the way

blocks.heading: Classes
items: Druid: Bloom now heals its target. Tooltips for Bear Form, Ravage and Swiftmend are corrected.
Mage: You no longer learn Research and lose it when you log out. Arcane Blast lasts 18 seconds.
Rogue: Shank tooltips now show the right rank and combo points.
Warlock: Your Voidwalker has about 40 more health. Soul Siphon no longer makes Wrack boost itself. Orc Command no longer over-boosts some pet abilities.
Warrior: The Reckless Swings tooltip now says it triggers Gore Drinker.
Quick and the Dead, a Legacy talent, now works every time.
Other players and their targets are easier to see from far away.

blocks.heading: Monsters and quests
items: Dun Morogh: troggs in Grol'bolar Quarry no longer respawn too fast.
Durotar: Ridgeshade Lurkers now drop loot.
Teldrassil: lashers are no longer immune to Nature damage.
"The Sleeper Has Awakened": Kerlonian falls asleep less, and you start with the Horn of Awakening.
"Never Saddle on Quality" has more spawns and drops. The Damp Note drops more often.
"Rediscovering the Light" lets you heal the NPCs again. "Vorsha the Lasher" no longer hits everyone in the zone.
Horde can pick up "Unending Torment" in the Ruins of Lordaeron at level 15, not 16.
Some Riverglades quest items are now shared with your group.

blocks.heading: Professions and dungeons
items: Leatherworking: the Tanning Rack now needs skill 125, down from 140.
Maraudon: Zaetar's Spirit appears after Princess Theradras. The Drowned City portal works again.
A proper fix for boats and zeppelins getting lost. Until it lands, temporary portals stand near the docks and zeppelin towers, and they'll be removed afterwards.
Population tuning for cities and other areas that feel emptier than intended.

blocks.heading: Monsters and quests
items: Durotar: Yarrog Baneshadow respawns at the intended speed.
Dustwallow Marsh: some murlocs no longer respawn too quickly.
Swamp of Sorrows: Pelluk now spawns reliably.
Deathstalker Erland respawns much faster for "Escorting Erland".
Text fixed in "The Sisterhood of Elune".

blocks.heading: Zephras Isle and items
items: Lotheluum Starbreeze now trains Druids.
Trade supply vendors sell apprentice tradeskill bags.
Mild Spices sell to vendors for 1 copper.

blocks.heading: Also on 4 and 5 Nov
items: Invite-a-Friend players can chat, level past 10, join guilds and parties, and trade again. Log out and back in if you were affected.
If chat or other players look wrong, check your language and social settings, then log out and back in.
Battlegrounds: Plainsrunning no longer stacks, and stacks are cancelled when you carry a flag.
Launch-week Twitch drop: watch 4 hours of eligible WoW streams for the Pouch of Violet Dust, a toy that colours campfires.

entries.label: Wed 4 Nov
entries.title: Launch notes: what affects your play

blocks.heading: Questing and interface
items: Learning a spell no longer puts it on your action bars, and new bags no longer equip themselves.
Quest objectives have tooltips and map markers.
Quest XP was adjusted. Monsters respawn faster in low-level zones, fastest in starting zones, and Blizzard plans to slow low-level zones to more typical rates once the launch rush settles.
Ruins of Lordaeron quests need level 15. "Holy Diver" now gives XP, and "Carnage" is fixed.
Some satyrs now count as demons.
Class training for every rank from 1 to 60 costs about 206 gold in total.
Gamepad support works, but Blizzard still calls it a beta and is updating its interface.

blocks.heading: Combat
items: Every class deals more damage, and higher-level monsters have more health.

Low spell ranks no longer lose their chance to trigger talents. The exception is the Mage spell Blizzard: ranks learned more than 12 levels below you still trigger Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost less often.
Racials: Orc Command is back, Blood Fury has a 2-minute cooldown, Berserking lasts 15 seconds, Touch of the Grave can trigger every 15 seconds, and racial weapon specializations are gone.

blocks.heading: By class
byClass: Berserk is gone. The new Feral capstones are Primal Bite and Shifting Power. Bear threat is 115%, Shred does 200% weapon damage, and Starfire hits 40% harder.
Aimed Shot’s bonus damage is up about 110%, Sniper Shot’s 100%, and Arcane Shot’s base damage about 30%. All traps share a 30-second cooldown.
Critical Mass gives 6% for 3 points. Ice Lance does 300% more to frozen targets on an 8-second cooldown. Ice Barrier also raises Frost damage. Frost Blast is gone.
Righteous Fury comes at level 10. Salvation, Mass Salvation, Revoke and Blessing of Light are gone. The new capstones are Unsealed Wrath and Shieldsworn.
Holy Binding replaces Binding Heal. Shadow Word: Death backlash is 30%.
Shank arrives at 24 and Poised at 18. Poisons scale twice as much with attack power. Mutilate is the Assassination capstone and Death Mark the Subtlety one.
Call of Thunder replaces Lava Burst. Top-rank Lightning Bolt hits 80% harder. Stormstrike does 150% weapon damage on a 6-second cooldown. Riptide is now a heal over time only.
Demons get 2 health per point of your Stamina, down from 7.5, so they're easier to lose. Wrack deals 86 damage a second at 60.
Defensive Stance threat is 80%. Slam has a 15-second cooldown. Reckless Swings and Improved Whirlwind are new talents.

blocks.heading: Known issues at launch
items: "No realms are currently available" (WOW51900309).
Faction locks, and some problems on the Roleplay and Roleplay PvP rulesets.

blocks.note: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair for level 60 characters. The World tab counts down to it.
